senses.gloss: Lopāmudrā, daughter of the Vidarbha king and wife of Agastya. § 11 (Parvasaṅgr.): I, 2, 442.--§ 382 (Agastyop.): III, 96, 8563 (created by Agastya as the daughter of the Vidarbha king); 97, 8571, 8574, 8576, 8577, 8582 (married to Agastya), 8589, (8590), (8592); 99, 8633, (8634), (8637) (mother of Dṛdhasyu or Idhmavāha).--§ 391 (Ṛshyaśṛṅga): III, 110, 10092 (Lºā vā yathā hy Agastyaṃ).--§ 410 (Plakshāvataraṇag.): III, 130, 10541 (etat Sindhor mahātīrthaṃ yatrāgastyam arindama|Lºā samāgamya bhartāram avṛṇīta vai, cf. § 382).--§ 551 (Kīśakavadhap.): IV, 21, 654 (ºā tathā bhīru vayorūpasamanvitā|Agastyam anvayād dhitvā kāmān sarvān amānushān). Cf. Vaidarbhī.
